title: Mathematical Methods Iii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the best methods used in handling problems involving mechanical vibrations."
The integral transform method is one of the best methods used in handling problems involving mechanical vibrations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined to be the inverse operation of addition."
Subtraction is defined to be the inverse operation of addition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method for solving differential equations and corresponding initial and boundary value problems."
The Laplace transform is a method for solving differential equations and corresponding initial and boundary value problems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most equations in physics, occurring in gravitation, electrostatics, fluid flow, etc. (cf. chaps. 11, 17) let us discover why this equation arises in complex analysis."

Laplace's equation is one of the most equations in physics, occurring in gravitation, electrostatics, fluid flow, etc. (cf. chaps. 11, 17) let us discover why this equation arises in complex analysis.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a functional determinant (whose elements are functions) which is very useful in transformation of variables from Cartesian to polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates in multiple integras."

Jacobian is a functional determinant (whose elements are functions) which is very useful in transformation of variables from Cartesian to polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates in multiple integras.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function whose derivative equals a given analytic function in a region."
An indefinite integral is a function whose derivative equals a given analytic function in a region.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the derivative of v(t )."
The vector is called the derivative of v(t ) .
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of your course."
The (TMA) is the continuous assessment component of your course.
